messages:
Alyssa: Heads-up: customer deployment review for AcmeCorp (moving from Dedicated -> Private VPC). Need to schedule a 60m run-through to validate network prep, capacity plan, and cutover checklist. Looking for Tue/Wed next week. Please post availability and any prep items.

Mike: Tue 09:30-11:00 PT good for me. I can cover capacity mapping and perf expectations.

Deepa: I have Tue morning as well. I'll bring the VPC peering and CIDR overlap verification. @Alyssa can you ask Acme for their network diagram & VPN details?

Victor: Wed 13:00-15:00 PT preferable on my side. If we lock Tue I'll attend and take storage/encryption questions.

Jenny: Either day works. I'll prep a 5-slide demo of the Private control plane and onboarding steps.

ops-bot: Poll created: https://cal.com/redwood/acme-private-review — voting open through EOD Fri.

Mike: Draft agenda idea:
- 5m quick intros & scope
- 15m network readiness (Deepa)
- 10m security & KMS/HSM (Victor)
- 15m capacity mapping (Mike)
- 10m cutover + rollback plan
- 5m actions and next steps

Alyssa: +1 to agenda. Add a slot to confirm firewall egress rules and telemetry endpoints. Also request the customer's data residency requirement up front.

Deepa: Preflight checklist I'm going to run and want validated on the call:
```
- Verify VPC peering / Transit GW
- CIDR overlap check
- BGP/VPN session health
- Route table + NAT rules for GPU nodes
- Egress allowlist for telemetry & metrics endpoints
```

Victor: Also need confirmation on KMS key ARNs and cross-account grants. If they require HSM or dedicated key wraps, provisioning lead time may affect cutover date.

Jenny: I'll attach a short deck and the onboarding runbook to the invite. Will include screenshots of the private control plane and required IAM roles.

Alyssa: Action list before meeting:
- Deepa: collect customer network diagram + run the CIDR overlap check
- Mike: produce capacity mapping doc comparing Dedicated flavor -> Private instance sizes
- Victor: validate KMS/HSM requirements and provisioning ETA
- Jenny: upload demo deck + runbook links to calendar invite
- Alyssa: invite customer infra and security leads, and SRE on the invite

Mike: I'll also export a brief perf profile of the Dedicated environment they're on today and annotate expected delta on Private.

Deepa: I'll post overlap check results in this thread once done.

ops-bot: Reminder: do not post secrets in channel. Use secure-share for any sensitive attachments.

Alyssa: If poll is still open, we'll reconvene Fri 16:00 PT to finalize invite and attendee list. If poll picks Tue, assume Tue 10:00 PT unless someone objects here.

Victor: Noted. If we go Tue, I'll prep a short note on key grant templates to email the customer's security contact so they can pre-provision.

Jenny: Added runbook link: https://secure.redwood/runbooks/private-onboard (will attach final slides to the invite).

Alyssa: Thanks — appreciate the quick responses. I'll follow up with the customer for the network diagram and confirm the poll window. :rocket:
